items.text: All 9 decisions from rounds 1 and 2 have been incorporated into plan.md. Round 2 decisions resolved: (d1=A) PipelineStateGateBlocked state added to Phase 3 and state machine description, (d2=B) approval creation placed as first op in deploy stage Execute() in Phase 4, (d3=A) no schema version bump confirmed in Phase 2 and Non-goals, (d4=A) concrete polling defaults (15s/2x/2m cap/30m timeout) integrated into Phase 2 DeployConfig and Phase 4 polling logic.

Plan now has 7 implementation phases (added Phase 3 for GateBlocked state machine work, renumbered subsequent phases) plus a final cleanup/verification step. All phases have concrete file paths, insertion points, and implementation details. No TBD sections remain.

Contract Decisions section updated: all 9 decisions moved to Settled with round references. No pending decisions remain. Non-goals section expanded with two new prohibited patterns derived from round 2 answers (no schema version bump, no orchestrator post-stage hooks).

Definition of Done expanded from 10 to 14 items to cover GateBlocked state machine (items 5, 9), lint/type error cleanup (item 13), and scenario health check (item 14). Testing plan expanded to include orchestrator state transition tests.
No remaining gaps identified. All readiness dimensions scored at 3/3. The plan is ready for execution.

plan_updates: Incorporated all 4 round-2 decisions. Added Phase 3 (GateBlocked state machine) and renumbered phases 4-7. Moved all Contract Decisions to Settled. Added greenfield statement to Implementation Strategy. Added orchestrator state transition tests to Testing Plan. Expanded Definition of Done to 14 items. Added cleanup/verification final step per plan-authoring conventions. Added two prohibited patterns to Non-goals.
